workbook_extraction.finding: Others repeats CAPEX cash and finance lease totals; CF repeats statutory acquisition cash outflows. No full reconciliation of the FY26 Q1 cash CAPEX difference was located in those sheets.

findings.detail: Financial highlights restate the CAPEX exclusion definition and IFRS16 cashflow classification; prior notes were not a hidden information gap.
sort03 and sort04 return byte-identical full-page bodies; they are two requests but only one distinct body. Neither provides the numeric bridge.

FY2025 p53 reports cash CAPEX 23430 and finance lease8778 for the year ended2026-03-31 with the same exclusion definition. Notes16 and35 discuss leases/noncash transactions; they do not establish the FY26 Q1 numerical bridge.

The four additional sources do not supply a full item-by-item numerical reconciliation from FY26 Q1 statutory acquisition cash outflows to management cash CAPEX. Do not infer that the bridge is undisclosed everywhere or fabricate the missing items.

FY2025 separate-company income statement p167 has a2157millionJPY grant-income line; equal amount to the FY26 Q1 consolidated cashflow does not alone establish matching scope or timing. Do not merge these into one realized-period earnings input.

The draft asks largely for a definition/reference already public. No current priced model, action switch or response likelihood supports a decision-changing information value for the still-unlocated numerical bridge. This is not a claim that EVSI is numerically zero.

conclusion.reason: Definition answered publicly; the remaining numeric bridge remains unresolved and has no demonstrated decision impact. Keep the accounting limitation rather than sending an unprioritized definition question.
